Rashi on Ketubot 59a:10:1.hebrew: אלא אמר רב יוסף - לעולם הלכה ומטעמיה קאמר, ומשום שמא יגרשנה:
Rashi on Ketubot 59a:10:1.english: Rather, Rav Yosef said - Actually, [Shmuel] meant both the halakha and his [own] reason, and [that reason is] because of [the concern] lest he divorce her.

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:10:2.english: And konamot are different - [This refers to] a consecration that is not a consecration for everyone, but rather [is imposed] upon one person through the expression "konam."

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:10:3.hebrew: מתוך - שהוא תופס במקום שאין סתם הקדש תופס, שאדם אוסר פירות חבירו עליו ואומר "קונם פירות פלוני עלי", ובסתם הקדש אין אדם מקדיש דבר שאינו שלו. הלכך, אדם אוסר עליו נמי דבר שלא בא לעולם, אבל מתני' במקדיש הקדש גמור איירי, ואינו ממהר לתפוס כקונם:
Rashi on Ketubot 59a:10:3.english: Since - [a konam] takes effect in a situation where ordinary consecration does not take effect, for a person can prohibit his fellow's produce to himself and say, "So-and-so's produce is konam to me," whereas with ordinary consecration a person cannot consecrate something that is not his. Therefore, a person can also prohibit to himself something that has not yet come into the world; but our Mishnah is dealing with one who consecrates [something with] full consecration, and it does not take effect as readily as a konam.

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:11:1.hebrew: אמר ליה אביי - ומה ראיה פירות חבירו עליו לכאן, שהן פירות חבירו על חבירו? דעכשיו היא משועבדת לו למעשה ידיה, ואינה ראויה להתפיסו בקונם, ולכשיגרשנה קאמר דחייל. ועוד, שעדיין לא נעשית המלאכה עד לאחר גירושין וחזרה:
Rashi on Ketubot 59a:11:1.english: Abaye said to him - And what proof [is there from] "another's produce to himself" to here, where they are "another's produce to another"? For now she is obligated to him for her handiwork, and is unable to bind it with a konam, and [it is only] when he divorces her that [the Mishnah] says it takes effect. And furthermore, the work has still not been done until after [her] divorce and return [to him].

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:11:2.hebrew: בשלמא אדם אוסר פירות חבירו עליו - בקונם, שהרי אדם אוסר פירותיו על חבירו, בין בלשון קונם לחבירו לבדו, בין שהקדישו סתם הקדש גמור:
Rashi on Ketubot 59a:11:2.english: Granted, a person can prohibit another’s produce to himself - With a konam, for a person can prohibit his [own] produce to another, whether with an expression of konam [prohibiting it] to that other alone, or whether he consecrated it unconditionally [as] complete hekdesh.

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:11:3.english: Should he prohibit something, etc. - [This is said] as a rhetorical question.

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:11:4.hebrew: שכן אין אדם כו' - שממקום שבאת אין אתה יכול ללמוד איסור, שהרי אף בקונם אין אוסר פירות חבירו על חבירו לומר "קונם פירותיך עליך":
Rashi on Ketubot 59a:11:4.english: Since a person cannot, etc. - For from the source from which you came, you cannot derive [such a] prohibition, since even with a konam [vow] one cannot prohibit another's produce to another [by] saying, "Konam, your produce [is prohibited] to you."

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:12:1.hebrew: באומרת יקדשו ידי כו' - שהמלאכה כמי שבאת לעולם, ועל הגירושין שלא באו קא מסיק ואזיל. ומתניתין באומר ״מעשה ידיך הקדש״:
Rashi on Ketubot 59a:12:1.english: When she says, "My hands shall be consecrated," etc. - For the work is [considered] as having come into the world, and [the Gemara] proceeds [to discuss] the divorce, which has not [yet] come [into the world]. And our Mishnah [refers to a case] where one says, "The work of your hands is consecrated."

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:14:1.hebrew: ומי איכא מידי כו' - כלומר, תירצת לא בא לעולם דמלאכה; לא בא לעולם דגירושין לא תירצת, דאילו השתא לית לה רשותא לאקדושיה, והיכי קדיש לקמיה:
Rashi on Ketubot 59a:14:1.english: And is there anything, etc. - That is to say: you resolved [the issue of] "not yet come into existence" regarding [her] handiwork; [but the issue of] "not yet come into existence" regarding divorce you did not resolve, for at present she does not have the authority to consecrate it, so how can it become consecrated later?

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:14:2.english: Why not - [This is] a rhetorical question.

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:14:3.english: Doesn't it become consecrated? - If he sold it and then bought it back.

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:15:1.hebrew: בידו להקדישה - שהרי עכשיו שלו, וכי היכי דאילו אקדשה השתא קדשה, כי אמר נמי תיקדוש לקמיה, קדשה:
Rashi on Ketubot 59a:15:1.english: It is in his power to consecrate it - For behold, [the field is] currently his, and just as if he consecrated it now it would be consecrated, so too when he says "let it be consecrated in the future," it is consecrated.

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:15:2.english: This is not comparable - It is the conclusion of the objection.

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:16:1.hebrew: התם - גבי מכרתי לך, אין לו עכשיו בה לא גוף ולא פירות, ואין אדם מקדיש דבר שאינו שלו:
Rashi on Ketubot 59a:16:1.english: There - Regarding [the case of] "I sold [this field] to you," he currently has in it neither [the field] itself nor [its] produce, and a person cannot consecrate something that is not his.

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:16:2.english: Here, her body is in her possession - And behold, "May my hands be consecrated," she said.

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:16:3.english: This is not comparable - It is the conclusion of his objection.

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:2:1.hebrew: מזונות שכיחי, ומעשה ידיה שכיח, ומותר לא שכיח. מעה כסף קייץ, ומעשה ידיה קייץ, כדתנן (לקמן כתובות דף סד:): מה היא עושה? משקל חמש סלעים:
Rashi on Ketubot 59a:2:1.english: Sustenance is common, and her handiwork is common, whereas surplus is not common. A silver ma'ah is fixed, and her handiwork is fixed, as we learned in the Mishnah (later, Ketubot 64b): "What must she produce? The weight of five sela'im."

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:4:1.english: But it is taught regarding it - in the Mishnah.

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:4:2.hebrew: ומה היא עושה לו - ומדפריש בתר מעשה ידיה "ומה היא עושה לו", מכלל דרישא במעשה ידיה איירי, ולא במותר:
Rashi on Ketubot 59a:4:2.english: And what does she make for him - And since [the Mishnah] specifies after [mentioning] her handiwork, "And what does she make for him," it follows that the first clause is dealing with her handiwork [itself], and not with the surplus.

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:4:3.english: Warp - [It is] harder to spin it than the woof.

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:5:1.hebrew: הכי קאמר - [לעולם במותר איירי ברישא, והכי קאמר] סיפא: "ומה היא עושה לו" — עיקר, דנדע מותר מאי ניהו:
Rashi on Ketubot 59a:5:1.english: This is what it is saying - Indeed, it is speaking of the surplus in the first clause, and this is what the latter clause [is saying]: "And what does she make for him" [refers to] the principal [amount], so that we may know what the surplus is.

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:5:2.english: The weight of five sela - A sela of Judea [is] double the weight of a sela of the Galilee.

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:7:1.hebrew: מי אמר שמואל הכי - והאמר שמואל לעיל במותר לאחר מיתה פליגי, ועלה א"ר יוחנן הסנדלר חולין, ואע"פ דהשתא דידיה הוא; אלמא טעמא דר' יוחנן משום דבר שלא בא לעולם הוא — שעדיין לא מתה, ואין לו רשות במותר, הואיל ואינו מעלה לה מעה כסף — ובהא אמר שמואל הלכה:
Rashi on Ketubot 59a:7:1.english: Did Shmuel say this - But didn't Shmuel say earlier [that] they disagree regarding the surplus after [her] death, and regarding that Rabbi Yochanan HaSandlar said [it is] non-sacred [chullin], even though right now [her earnings] belong to him? Thus, Rabbi Yochanan's reason is because [it is] something that has not yet come into the world — for she has not yet died, and he has no rights to the surplus [after her death], since he does not provide her with a ma'ah of silver — and regarding this, Shmuel said [the] halakha [follows Rabbi Yochanan HaSandlar]?

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:7:2.hebrew: והתנן קונם שאני עושה לפיך - מה שאני עושה יהיה קונם לפיך, יהי עליך כהקדש מליהנות לו:
Rashi on Ketubot 59a:7:2.english: But didn't we learn: "Konam [that] which I make for your mouth" - [Meaning,] what I make shall be konam for your mouth — let it be upon you like consecrated property, [forbidden] from benefiting from it.

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:7:3.hebrew: אינו צריך להפר - נדר זה, שאין בה כח להקדישו, לפי שהוא שלו:
Rashi on Ketubot 59a:7:3.english: He does not need to nullify - this vow, because she does not have the power to consecrate it, since it is his.

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:7:4.hebrew: שמא תעדיף עליו - יותר ממה שפסקו לה חכמים — משקל חמש סלעים — דמותר זה אינו שלו, ויכולה להקדישו:
Rashi on Ketubot 59a:7:4.english: Lest she produce more for him - [i.e.,] more than what the Sages allotted to her — the weight of five sela'im — for this surplus is not his, and she can consecrate it.

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:7:5.hebrew: ר' יוחנן בן נורי אומר - אף עיקר מעשה ידיה צריך הפרה:
Rashi on Ketubot 59a:7:5.english: Rabbi Yoḥanan ben Nuri says - Even the principal of her handiwork requires nullification.

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:7:6.hebrew: שמא יגרשנה - ויהא הנדר חל, שמשגרשה אינה משועבדת לו למעשה ידיה:
Rashi on Ketubot 59a:7:6.english: Lest he divorce her - and the vow will take effect, for once he divorces her, she is not obligated to him for her handiwork.

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:7:7.hebrew: ותהא אסורה לחזור לו - לפי שנאסר מעשה ידיה עליו, ואי אפשר לו ליזהר שלא תטחון ולא תאפה וכל שאר מלאכות השנויות במשנתנו שהאשה עושה לבעלה:
Rashi on Ketubot 59a:7:7.english: And she will be prohibited from returning to him - Because her handiwork has become forbidden to him, and it is impossible for him to be careful that she neither grind nor bake, nor [perform] all the other tasks taught in our Mishnah that a wife performs for her husband.

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:8:1.hebrew: ואמר שמואל הלכה כו' - אלמא לכשיגרשנה חל הנדר, אלמא אדם מקדיש דבר שלא בא לעולם, שעדיין לא גירשה:
Rashi on Ketubot 59a:8:1.english: And Shmuel said: The halakha, etc. - Thus, when he divorces her, the vow takes effect; thus, a person can consecrate something that has not yet come into the world, since he has not yet divorced her.

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:8:2.hebrew: כי אמר שמואל הלכה כר' יוחנן בן נורי להעדפה - קאמר. כלומר: הלכה דיפר, ולאו מטעמיה; דאילו לר' יוחנן, עיקר מעשה ידיה צריך הפרה, ולשמואל, משום העדפה — שמא תעדיף על הראוי — הוא דאמר יפר. והשתא נמי הוה מצי לאקשויי: סוף סוף לא בא לעולם, דהא לא נעשה. אלא אקשי ליה קושיא אחריתא:
Rashi on Ketubot 59a:8:2.english: When Shmuel said [that] the halakha is in accordance with Rabbi Yoḥanan ben Nuri, [he was referring] to the surplus - [This is what he] meant: that is to say, the halakha is that he must annul [her vow], though not for his [Rabbi Yoḥanan's] reason. For according to Rabbi Yoḥanan, [even] the principal of her handiwork requires annulment; whereas according to Shmuel, it is because of the surplus — lest she produce more than what is fitting [for her] — that he said he must annul [it]. And even now, [the Gemara] could have asked: After all, [the surplus] has not come into the world, for it has not [yet] been produced! Rather, [it] raised a different objection against him.

Rashi on Ketubot 59a:9:1.hebrew: אין הלכה כת"ק - דאמר אין צריך להפר, אלא יפר:
Rashi on Ketubot 59a:9:1.english: The halakha is not in accordance with the first tanna - Who said [that] he does not need to nullify [the vow]; rather, he must nullify [it].

Tosafot on Ketubot 59a:11:1.hebrew: בשלמא אדם אוסר פירות חבירו עליו שכן אוסר פירותיו על חבירו - פירוש: דהתם אוסר משום דאחד מהן ברשותו. "יאסור דבר שלא בא לעולם על חבירו" — שאין לא זה ולא זה ברשותו; "שכן אין אדם אוסר פירות חבירו על חבירו" — לפי ששניהן אינם ברשותו:
Tosafot on Ketubot 59a:11:1.english: "Granted, a person can prohibit another's produce to himself, since [he] can prohibit his own produce to another" - Explanation: There he can prohibit [it] because one of them is in his domain. "[Can he] prohibit an object that has not come into the world to another" — for neither this nor that is in his domain; "since a person cannot prohibit another's produce to another" — because both of them are not in his domain.

Tosafot on Ketubot 59a:14:1.hebrew: לכשאקחנה ממך כו' - ואע"ג דהתם קאמר "לכשאקחנה" והכא לא קאמרה "לכשאתגרש", אין נראה לו לחלק:
Tosafot on Ketubot 59a:14:1.english: "When I buy it from you," etc. - And even though there he says "when I buy it," and here she does not say "when I am divorced," it does not appear [correct] to him to distinguish [between the two cases].

Tosafot on Ketubot 59a:15:1.hebrew: הכא אין בידה לגרש עצמה - תימה, דהא בידה לומר "איני ניזונת ואיני עושה". ויש לומר דרוצה ליישב גם אליבא דריש לקיש:
Tosafot on Ketubot 59a:15:1.english: "Here, it is not in her power to divorce herself" - [This is] astonishing, for it is in her power to say, "I will not be sustained and I will not work." And one can say that [he] wants to reconcile [this] even according to Reish Lakish.

Tosafot on Ketubot 59a:7:1.hebrew: קונם שאני עושה לפיך - אפילו גרסי' "שאיני", לא הוי דבר שאין בו ממש, דהא תנן בפ' בתרא דנדרים (דף פא:): "קונם שלא אתן תבן לפני בקרך" — אינו יכול להפר:
Tosafot on Ketubot 59a:7:1.english: Konam what I make for your mouth - Even if we read "that I will not [make for your mouth]," it is not [considered] something without substance, for we learned in the last chapter of Nedarim (81b): "Konam that I will not place straw before your cattle" — he cannot nullify [it].

Tosafot on Ketubot 59a:7:2.hebrew: אינו צריך להפר - במעלה לה מזונות ומעה כסף איירי, ולכך אינו צריך להפר, שהמותר הכל שלו; ואם משום העדפה שעל ידי הדחק, גם היא שלו. ואין לפרש טעם דאין צריך להפר משום דאין אדם מקדיש דבר שלא בא לעולם, דאם כן, בחנם נקט "מה שאני עושה לפיך", דליתני "מקדיש ידי עצמו":
Tosafot on Ketubot 59a:7:2.english: He does not need to nullify [it] - [The Mishnah] is dealing with [a husband] who provides her with sustenance and a silver ma'ah, and therefore he does not need to nullify [her vow], for all the surplus is his; and if [one objects] regarding surplus [produced] through extraordinary exertion, that too is his. And one should not explain that the reason he does not need to nullify [it] is because a person cannot consecrate something that has not yet come into existence, for if so, [the Mishnah] unnecessarily stated "what I make for your mouth," as it could have taught "one who consecrates his own hands":

Tosafot on Ketubot 59a:7:3.hebrew: רבי עקיבא אומר יפר - דקסבר דהעדפה שעל ידי הדחק הוי לאשה, כדאמרינן בריש מציאת האשה (לקמן כתובות סו. ושם). וא"ת: והיאך יכול להפר, והא אין זה מדברים שבינו לבינה? וי"ל, דחשיב בינו לבינה, לפי שאינו יכול ליזהר וליקח ממש בצמצום את הראוי לו, ולהניח שאינו ראוי לו; א"נ, גם חלקה משועבד לו, שילקח בהם קרקע והוא יאכל פירות. וא"ת: אם כן, איך יכולה להדירו, כיון דמשועבדת ליה, דאלמוה רבנן לשעבודיה דבעל, כדאמר בסמוך? וי"ל, דדוקא בעיקר מעשה ידיה הוא דאלמוה, שהם לבעל לגמרי; אבל הכא, דלאו דידיה נינהו אלא לפירות בעלמא, לא אלמוה:
Tosafot on Ketubot 59a:7:3.english: Rabbi Akiva says: He should nullify - For he holds that surplus [earned] through exertion belongs to the wife, as we say at the beginning of [the chapter] Metziat HaIshah (below, Ketubot 66a and there). And if you ask: How can he nullify [it], since this is not among matters between him and her? One can answer that it is considered between him and her, because he cannot be careful to take precisely what is appropriate for him and leave what is not appropriate for him; alternatively, her portion is also liened to him, so that land should be bought with it and he consumes the produce. And if you ask: If so, how can she forbid [it] to him by a vow, since it is liened to him, for the Rabbis strengthened the husband's lien, as it says nearby? One can answer that specifically regarding the principal of her handiwork did they strengthen [his lien], since it belongs to the husband completely; but here, where it is not his except merely for the produce, they did not strengthen [it].

Tosafot on Ketubot 59a:7:4.hebrew: שמא יגרשנה כו' - ואם תאמר: ולרב דאמר יכולה אשה שתאמר לבעלה "איני ניזונת ואיני עושה", למה לי למנקט "שמא יגרשנה"? לימא "שמא תאמר איני ניזונת ואיני עושה"! וי"ל, דהא לא שכיח שתהא אומרת כן:
Tosafot on Ketubot 59a:7:4.english: "Lest he divorce her," etc. - And if you ask: According to Rav, who says a woman can say to her husband, "I will not be supported [by you] and I will not work [for you]," why does [the Tanna] need to state "lest he divorce her"? Let him say, "lest she say, 'I will not be supported and I will not work'"! And one can answer that it is not common for her to say so.

Tosafot on Ketubot 59a:8:1.hebrew: כי אמר שמואל הלכה כרבי יוחנן בן נורי להעדפה - פירוש הקונטרס מגומגם, כמו שפירש בעצמו. ונראה לר"ת דהכי פירושו: "להעדפה" — דסבר לה שמואל כרבי יוחנן בן נורי בהא, דהעדפה לבעל. ובתר הכי גריס: "ונימא הלכה כתנא קמא, אי נמי אין הלכה כרבי עקיבא", וכן פירש ר"ח:
Tosafot on Ketubot 59a:8:1.english: "When Shmuel said [that] the halakha is in accordance with Rabbi Yoḥanan ben Nuri, [he was referring] to the surplus" - Rashi's explanation is forced, as he himself explained. And it appears to Rabbeinu Tam that this is its explanation: "[He was referring] to the surplus" — meaning that Shmuel agrees with Rabbi Yoḥanan ben Nuri on this [point], that the surplus belongs to the husband. And after this, [Rabbeinu Tam] reads [the text as]: "Let him say: The halakha is in accordance with the Tanna Kamma, or alternatively: The halakha is not in accordance with Rabbi Akiva," and so explained Rabbeinu Ḥananel:
